title: Constrain certified control-error classification by operation and admission-card provenance
outcome: Constrain certified control-error classification by operation and admission-card provenance
acceptance: Audit the producer contract's supported control operations and scope non-application diagnostics accordingly, with negative tests for unrelated operations and Refuse-derived errors.

Automatic admission retry for the certified code strings requires the matching causal provenance; forged or producer-refusal cards cannot acquire retry authority, while earlier uncertain Begin replay remains supported.
